name: Wheel-rail interaction element (WRIE)
definition_zh: 本文中由轮轨相互作用力激励的强迫振动单元形式。
definition_en: The wheel–rail coupling formulation represented as a system excited by wheel–rail interaction forces in the cited study.
usage_overview: 用于列车—轨道动力建模，通过轮轨相互作用力连接车辆与轨道的响应，将两者之间的动力耦合纳入单元的强迫振动表述。

complete_examples.text: Recently, wheel-rail interaction element (WRIE) [23] is proposed by considering the ‘additional’ displacement of the rail, in which Newton iterative process should be implemented to guarantee the solution convergence since the wheel and rail are not coupled in a unified matrix.
